The '''Webweaver caverns''' was an underground cavern found beneath the [[Nawataa Waterfall]] in the [[Kkowir Forest/Legends|Kkowir Forest]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. The cavern was infested by [[Spider/Legends|spiders]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Webweaver caverns first appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
